test_title: PYST 54: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: What is one of the downsides of social media mentioned in the passage?

options.text: It can help connect with people all over the globe.
It's a great way to stay connected with friends and family.
It encourages people to enjoy the little moments in life.
It can lead to pressure to present a perfect life online.

solution:
The correct answer is **'It can lead to pressure to present a perfect life online.'**

• In paragraph 3, the passage mentions **the pressure to present the perfect life online as a downside of social media.**
